en.title: Snow in China's ski areas today: Altay leads, Chongli waits for natural snow (27 November)
en.description: 45 of 130 ski areas in northern China have natural snow today. Hemu has 70 cm, Koktokay 40 cm; around Chongli the natural snow is still under 10 cm.
en.lede: The ski season in China has started in two very different ways. In the Altay and Tianshan mountains of northern Xinjiang, natural snow already covers the upper slopes: Hemu has about 70 cm and Koktokay about 40 cm on 27 November 2026. Around Beijing and Chongli, where most Chinese skiers go, the natural snow is still thin, and the runs that are open are built on machine-made snow. SnowScope now maps the snow of northern China every day, and this is the first picture.

sections.h: The big picture: 45 ski areas with natural snow
p: Our China map follows 130 ski areas in two parts of the country: the north-east, from Beijing and Zhangjiakou to Jilin and Heilongjiang, and the north of Xinjiang, from the Altay to the Tianshan. Today 45 of them have some natural snow on their upper slopes, 16 have at least 10 cm and only 4 have 30 cm or more.

Those four are all in Xinjiang. That is no surprise at this time of year: the Altay sits far inland at the edge of Siberian air, its winters start early, and the snow that falls there in late autumn usually stays, because the air is so cold and dry. The north-east gets most of its snow later, with the big outbreaks of cold air of December and January.

sections.h: Xinjiang: Hemu, Koktokay and the Tianshan
p: In northern Xinjiang 12 of the 14 ski areas on the map have natural snow, and 9 of them have at least 10 cm. Hemu, the big new ski area of the Altay at the edge of the Kanas valley, leads with about 70 cm on its upper slopes, 6 cm of it new in the last three days. Its lifts reach 2,765 m.

Koktokay, the high ski area of Fuyun county with a top at 3,077 m, has about 40 cm. In the Tianshan, Nalati Hayinsai in the Ili valley also has about 40 cm, and Xiyu about 36 cm. Jiangjunshan, the ski area right above Altay city, is lower, with a top at 1,319 m, and has about 23 cm, 3 cm of it fresh.

If you want to ski on natural snow in China this weekend, these are the places. The snow is still early-season snow: the base is good on the groomed runs, but off them rocks and grass can be close to the surface.

sections.h: Beijing and Chongli: machine snow first
p: Around Beijing and Zhangjiakou, the area of the 2022 Winter Olympics, our map follows 38 ski areas. Only 11 of them show any natural snow today, and none has 10 cm. Wanlong and the Snow Ruyi jumping centre have about 7 cm on the upper slopes, Genting and Thaiwoo about 6 cm. No new snow fell here in the last three days.

This does not mean the season has not started. The big Chongli areas make snow from November whenever the nights are cold enough, and they open their main runs on that machine snow long before the natural snow is deep. So the numbers on our map are the natural snow on the mountain, not the state of the groomed pistes: check the ski area's own report for open runs and lifts.

In the north-east beyond Beijing, 17 of 61 ski areas have natural snow and 7 have at least 10 cm. The deepest is the Changbai Mountain Natural Ski Park in Jilin, with about 25 cm after 5 cm of new snow in three days. Riyuexia has about 11 cm, 9 cm of it fresh, and Yabuli and Longzhu Erlongshan about 10 cm each.

Further west in Inner Mongolia, the Arxan area has about 9 cm, 6 cm of it new. The big Jilin resorts near Jilin city, Beidahu and Songhua Lake, still have little natural snow; like Chongli, they rely on snowmaking at the start of the season.

SnowScope gives the natural snow on the upper slopes of each ski area, estimated every day for the whole region. The map and the resort pages show the same numbers, with a forecast for the next days and alerts when new snow is coming. Our next post looks at the week ahead, ski area by ski area.

advice: For natural snow this weekend, go to the Altay or the Tianshan: Hemu, Koktokay, Nalati or Jiangjunshan.
Around Chongli and Beijing, ski the groomed machine-snow runs and check which runs are open before you go.
Early-season snow is thin off the pistes: stay on the marked runs.
The Altay is very cold in late November: dress in layers and protect your face and hands.

zh.title: 中国滑雪场今日雪况：阿勒泰领先，崇礼还在等天然雪（11月27日）
zh.description: 中国北方 130 家滑雪场中有 45 家有天然积雪。禾木约 70 厘米，可可托海约 40 厘米；崇礼一带的天然积雪仍不到 10 厘米。
zh.lede: 中国的雪季以两种截然不同的方式开始了。在新疆北部的阿尔泰山和天山，天然雪已经覆盖了山上部的雪道：2026年11月27日，禾木约有 70 厘米，可可托海约有 40 厘米。而在大多数中国滑雪者常去的北京和崇礼一带，天然雪还很薄，已经开放的雪道靠的是人造雪。SnowScope 从现在起每天绘制中国北方的雪况地图，这是第一张全景图。

sections.h: 整体情况：45 家滑雪场有天然积雪
p: 我们的中国地图覆盖两个区域的 130 家滑雪场：一是从北京、张家口到吉林、黑龙江的东北和华北地区，二是从阿勒泰到天山的新疆北部。今天其中 45 家的山上部有天然积雪，16 家至少有 10 厘米，只有 4 家达到 30 厘米或以上。
这 4 家全部在新疆。每年这个时候都是如此：阿勒泰深居内陆，紧邻西伯利亚冷空气，冬天来得早，深秋落下的雪通常不会化掉，因为空气又冷又干。东北的降雪大多要等到十二月和一月的强冷空气。

sections.h: 新疆：禾木、可可托海和天山
p: 在新疆北部，地图上的 14 家滑雪场中有 12 家有天然积雪，其中 9 家至少有 10 厘米。阿勒泰喀纳斯边上的大型新雪场禾木（吉克普林）国际滑雪度假区以山上部约 70 厘米领先，其中 6 厘米是过去三天的新雪。缆车最高到 2,765 米。
富蕴县的高海拔雪场可可托海，顶部海拔 3,077 米，积雪约 40 厘米。天山方面，伊犁河谷的那拉提哈茵赛滑雪场同样约有 40 厘米，西域滑雪场约 36 厘米。阿勒泰市旁边的将军山滑雪场海拔较低，顶部 1,319 米，积雪约 23 厘米，其中 3 厘米是新雪。
如果这个周末想在中国滑天然雪，就去这些地方。不过这仍是早季的雪：压雪道上的雪底不错，但雪道以外，石头和草可能离雪面很近。

sections.h: 北京和崇礼：先靠人造雪
p: 在北京和张家口，也就是 2022 年冬奥会的举办地，我们的地图覆盖 38 家滑雪场。今天只有 11 家显示有天然积雪，没有一家达到 10 厘米。万龙和雪如意山上部约有 7 厘米，云顶和太舞约有 6 厘米。过去三天这里没有新的降雪。
这并不意味着雪季还没开始。崇礼的大型雪场从十一月起，只要夜里够冷就开始造雪，早在天然雪变厚之前，主要雪道就已经靠人造雪开放了。所以地图上的数字是山上的天然积雪，而不是压雪道的状况：开放的雪道和缆车请以滑雪场官方信息为准。
在北京以外的东北地区，61 家滑雪场中有 17 家有天然积雪，7 家至少有 10 厘米。积雪最厚的是吉林的长白山天然滑雪场，约 25 厘米，过去三天新增 5 厘米。日月峡约 11 厘米，其中 9 厘米是新雪；亚布力和龙珠二龙山各约 10 厘米。
再往西到内蒙古，阿尔山一带约有 9 厘米，其中 6 厘米是新雪。吉林市附近的大型雪场北大湖和松花湖目前天然雪还不多；和崇礼一样，它们在雪季初期靠造雪开板。
SnowScope 给出的是每家滑雪场山上部的天然积雪，每天对整个地区进行估算。地图和滑雪场页面显示的是同样的数字，还有未来几天的预报，以及新雪来临时的提醒。下一篇文章将逐个滑雪场介绍未来一周的降雪。

advice: 这个周末想滑天然雪，就去阿尔泰山或天山：禾木、可可托海、那拉提或将军山。
在崇礼和北京周边，请滑压好的人造雪道，出发前查看哪些雪道已经开放。
早季雪道以外的雪很薄：请留在有标记的雪道上。
十一月底的阿勒泰非常寒冷：多穿几层衣服，护好脸和手。
